items.headline: Jamestown resident indicted in Ohio college funds case
items.blurb: An Ohio grand jury indicted Jamestown resident Michael Perik on 12 felony counts tied to an alleged $20 million diversion from Eastern Gateway Community College. His attorney says no crimes occurred; the allegations are unproven.

items.headline: Police chief honored by council for bridge rescue
items.blurb: At its Oct. 19 meeting the town council recognized Police Chief Jamie Campbell, who on Sept. 16 stopped on the Verrazzano Bridge and helped a woman in crisis to safety. He will receive the department's Life-Saving Award.

items.headline: State police detective charged with DUI on North Main Road
items.blurb: Jamestown police charged a Rhode Island State Police detective with suspicion of DUI and refusal to submit to a chemical test after a stop late Oct. 15 on North Main Road. He is presumed innocent; State Police called it an open personnel matter.

items.headline: Jamestown police part of $65K crisis-intervention training grant
items.blurb: The Rhode Island Foundation awarded $65,000 to Crisis Intervention Teams of Rhode Island to train officers in Jamestown and five other Aquidneck-area towns on behavioral health calls.

items.headline: Smithfield man charged in 1985 cold-case killing of Jamestown woman
items.blurb: A 61-year-old Smithfield man was arraigned in Newport District Court on a first-degree murder charge after the Attorney General's cold case unit used new DNA analysis. He is held without bail and is presumed innocent.

items.headline: No suspects after state police Flock camera near bridge knocked down
items.blurb: State police say they have no leads after the Flock license-plate camera on Route 138 near the Helm Street exit was knocked down in August; they are seeking tips.

items.headline: Jamestown man arrested on reckless driving warrant
items.blurb: Rhode Island State Police arrested a 52-year-old Jamestown man at his Howland Avenue home on a reckless driving warrant. He was arraigned and released with a court date.
